I did not have a good relationship with my late mum. We fought all the time and when my dad passed away, i felt that it was me against the whole family. I wanted to run away from home and cut ties with everyone. But then, mama's health got worse

and suddenly , I become the head of the family. Out of responsibilities being the eldest child, I took over the roles. Make sure my siblings doing well in school The house management Mama's hospital treatment

The old me will have keep quiet and pasrah. But that day, I fought till my mum got her morphine. 6 days later, she passed away. And suddenly, I have to do everything. the burial, the death cert , the will , the siblings , the house

all at the age of 24 years. Between my dad death and my mum, I did not have the time to grief. I think, only recently I start the process. I still believe my parents are vacationing somewhere and they will come back soon.
